title: Marsdenia tenacissima injection induces the apoptosis of prostate cancer by regulating the AKT/GSK3beta/STAT3 signaling axis.
authors: Li, Xiaolan; He, Songhua; Liang, Wei; Zhang, Weiquan; Chen, Xin; Li, Qiaofeng; Yang, Xin; Liu, Yanying; Zhu, Dan; Li, Li; Liu, Buming; Su, Zhiheng; Chen, Jie; Guo, Hongwei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药注射剂诱导前列腺癌细胞凋亡的机制，仅含少量分子对接且对象为蛋白-小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Marsdenia tenacissima injection, a standard Marsdenia tenacissima extract (MTE), has been approved as an adjuvant therapeutic agent for various cancers. Our previous study showed that MTE inhibited the proliferation and metastasis of prostate cancer (PCa) cells. However, the underlying mechanisms and active ingredients of MTE against PCa were not completely understood. This study revealed that MTE induced significant decreases in cell viability and clonal growth in PCa cells. In addition, MTE induced the apoptosis of DU145 cells by reducing the mitochondrial membrane potential and increasing the expression of Cleaved Caspase 3/7, Cyt c, and Bax. In vivo, DU145 xenografted NOD-SCID mice treated with MTE showed significantly decreased tumor size. TUNEL staining and Western blot confirmed the pro-apoptotic effects of MTE. Network pharmacology analysis collected 196 ingredients of MTE linked to 655 potential targets, and 709 PCa-associated targets were retrieved, from which 149 overlapped targets were screened out. Pathway enrichment analysis showed that the HIF-1, PI3K-AKT, and ErbB signaling pathways were closely related to tumor apoptosis. Western blot results confirmed that MTE increased the expression of p-AKT(Ser473) and p-GSK3beta(Ser9), and decreased the expression of p-STAT3(Tyr705)in vitro and in vivo. A total of 13 compounds in MTE were identified by HPLC-CAD-QTOF-MS/MS and UPLC-QTOF-MS/MS. Molecular docking analysis indicated that six compounds may interact with AKT, GSK3beta, and STAT3. In conclusion, MTE induces the endogenous mitochondrial apoptosis of PCa by regulating the AKT/GSK3beta/STAT3 signaling axis, resulting in inhibition of PCa growth in vitro and in vivo.
abstract_zh: Marsdenia tenacissima注射液，作为一种标准的Marsdenia tenacissima提取物（MTE），已被批准作为多种癌症的辅助治疗药物。我们先前的研究表明，MTE抑制了前列腺癌（PCa）细胞的增殖和转移。然而，MTE对抗PCa的潜在机制和活性成分尚未完全明了。本研究揭示，MTE在PCa细胞中显著降低了细胞活力和克隆形成。此外，MTE通过降低线粒体膜电位并增加Cleaved Caspase 3/7、Cyt c和Bax的表达，诱导了DU145细胞的凋亡。在体内实验中，接受MTE治疗的DU145异种移植NOD-SCID小鼠显示出显著缩小的肿瘤体积。TUNEL染色和Western blot证实了MTE的促凋亡作用。网络药理学分析收集了MTE的196种成分，关联到655个潜在靶点，并检索到709个PCa相关靶点，从中筛选出149个重叠靶点。通路富集分析显示，HIF-1、PI3K-AKT和ErbB信号通路与肿瘤凋亡密切相关。Western blot结果证实，MTE在体外和体内均增加了p-AKT(Ser473)和p-GSK3beta(Ser9)的表达，并降低了p-STAT3(Tyr705)的表达。通过HPLC-CAD-QTOF-MS/MS和UPLC-QTOF-MS/MS鉴定了MTE中的13种化合物。分子对接分析表明，六种化合物可能与AKT、GSK3beta和STAT3相互作用。总之，MTE通过调节AKT/GSK3beta/STAT3信号轴诱导PCa的内源性线粒体凋亡，从而在体外和体内抑制PCa生长。
